"""Run TRAJ inference with 8-bit quantization."""
import os
os.environ["CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES"] = "2"
import json
import torch
from peft import PeftModel
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer, BitsAndBytesConfig

SYSTEM_PROMPT = (
    "You are a code repair verifier. Given the code patch and test summary, "
    "predict whether all tests pass (resolved) or any test fails (unresolved)."
)

def load_jsonl(path):
    with open(path) as f:
        return [json.loads(line) for line in f]

def parse_prediction(text):
    if "</think>" in text:
        text = text.split("</think>")[-1]
    text = text.strip().lower()
    if text.startswith("resolved"):
        return 1
    if text.startswith("unresolved"):
        return 0
    if "resolved" in text and "unresolved" not in text:
        return 1
    if "unresolved" in text:
        return 0
    return -1

def main():
    model_name = "/root/autodl-tmp/models/deepseek-ai/deepseek-coder-6.7b-instruct"
    checkpoint_dir = "/root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints_deepseek_traj_v2/best"
    data_path = "/home/sonny/exec-sim-repair-verifier/data/traj_test.jsonl"
    output_path = "/root/autodl-tmp/eval_results/deepseek_traj_func_s42/predictions.jsonl"
    max_seq_length = 2048

    print("Loading model in 8-bit...", flush=True)
    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(model_name, trust_remote_code=True)
    if tokenizer.pad_token is None:
        tokenizer.pad_token = tokenizer.eos_token
    tokenizer.padding_side = "left"

    bnb_config = BitsAndBytesConfig(load_in_8bit=True)
    model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(
        model_name, quantization_config=bnb_config, device_map="auto", trust_remote_code=True
    )
    print("Loading LoRA adapter...", flush=True)
    model = PeftModel.from_pretrained(model, checkpoint_dir)
    model.eval()
    print("Model ready.", flush=True)

    data = load_jsonl(data_path)
    print(f"Loaded {len(data)} test instances", flush=True)

    majority_class = 1 if sum(1 for d in data if d["label"] == 1) > len(data) // 2 else 0
    predictions = []
    n_unparseable = 0

    for i, d in enumerate(data):
        user_msg = f"[Code]\n{d['code']}\n\n[Test Summary]\n{d['test_summary']}"
        msgs = [
            {"role": "system", "content": SYSTEM_PROMPT},
            {"role": "user", "content": user_msg},
        ]
        result = tokenizer.apply_chat_template(
            msgs, tokenize=True, add_generation_prompt=True,
        )
        ids = result["input_ids"] if hasattr(result, "keys") else result
        if len(ids) > max_seq_length:
            ids = ids[:max_seq_length]

        input_ids = torch.tensor([ids], device=model.device)

        with torch.no_grad():
            outputs = model.generate(
                input_ids=input_ids,
                max_new_tokens=32,
                do_sample=False,
                pad_token_id=tokenizer.pad_token_id,
            )

        gen_ids = outputs[0][len(ids):]
        gen_text = tokenizer.decode(gen_ids, skip_special_tokens=True)
        pred = parse_prediction(gen_text)
        if pred == -1:
            n_unparseable += 1
            pred = majority_class

        predictions.append({
            "index": i,
            "problem_id": d["problem_id"],
            "mutation_type": d["mutation_type"],
            "label": d["label"],
            "pred": pred,
            "correct": int(pred == d["label"]),
            "gen_text": gen_text.strip(),
        })

        if (i + 1) % 50 == 0 or i == len(data) - 1:
            acc_so_far = sum(p["correct"] for p in predictions) / len(predictions) * 100
            print(f"Progress: {i+1}/{len(data)}, acc: {acc_so_far:.1f}%", flush=True)

    with open(output_path, "w") as f:
        for p in predictions:
            f.write(json.dumps(p) + "\n")

    acc = sum(p["correct"] for p in predictions) / len(predictions) * 100
    print(f"\nDone. Accuracy: {acc:.2f}%, unparseable: {n_unparseable}", flush=True)
    print(f"Saved to {output_path}", flush=True)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
PYEOF
